status_notes: Umbrella GE disclosure entry cross-referencing GE Vernova (secid:disclosure/gevernova.com/cna) and GE HealthCare (secid:disclosure/gehealthcare.com/cna).
official_name: General Electric Company (GE Aerospace / GE Vernova / GE HealthCare)
notes: Following the 2023–2024 corporate separation of General Electric into three independent companies, industrial/OT power and grid automation products (formerly GE Digital, GE Power, GE Grid Solutions) are covered by GE Vernova PSIRT (secid:disclosure/gevernova.com/cna, CNA-2022-0009), medical devices are covered by GE HealthCare (secid:disclosure/gehealthcare.com/cna, CNA-2022-0018), and aviation systems are operated by GE Aerospace (ge.com).
